$comment: The registry of the official templates. create-pluto and the store on the Pluto site read it. Each id is a folder in templates/.

templates.name: Blog (minimalist)
templates.description: Posts, search and a light and dark mode. No UI library: Tailwind CSS and a few components.

templates.name: Shop (Supabase)
templates.description: A product catalog: photos, categories, stock, search and two languages, on Nuxt UI.

templates.name: Dashboard only
templates.description: No public site: the Pluto admin and the public API, for a site in any stack.
